description: Wears tactical number 5037. Polish-built Lim-6bis; the OSM name and the linked dolny-slask.org.pl page disagree on whether it is a Lim-6bisR or a Lim-6R reconnaissance conversion so the variant field is left blank. Mapillary street-level imagery confirms the airframe in place
